title: Video from the Armory Museum
content: (Direct link to YouTube video) I shot some video last week while I did that little painting of field combat armor, and here's the result.In the video, you'll see a few glimpses of my friends painting. So that you can see their work a little more clearly, here are some better scans. Please check back later, because there are more images to come.Sean Murray, study of Papal guard armor, pen and watercolor.Greg Shea, pen and ink.Jeanette Gurney, pencil, watercolor, and a little white gouache.Garin Baker"The Higgins Armory"Chad Smith, "Romanesque Ceremonial Armor"And in case you missed it, here's the painting I did of the field combat armor using watercolor and casein, 5x8 inches.
